# Third-party material

| What | Where in the app | License |
|---|---|---|
| Literata (variable font, trimmed to weights 300 to 400, optical sizes 24 to 72 and Latin) | `app/src/main/res/font/literata.ttf` and static `literata_*.ttf` instances | SIL OFL 1.1, `fonts/Literata-OFL.txt` |
| Instrument Sans (variable font) | `app/src/main/res/font/instrument_sans.ttf` and static `instrument_sans_*.ttf` instances | SIL OFL 1.1, `fonts/InstrumentSans-OFL.txt` |

Static instances are generated by `scripts/static-fonts.py` for APIs 21 through 25.
They retain their source fonts' licenses and names; neither declares a Reserved
Font Name. All font files are bundled locally, with no runtime downloads.

The same two fonts are used, from those files, to render text to pixels in
Hearth's banner (`design/brand/`) and the demo app banners (`design/demo-apps/`).
The OFL allows this; the rendered images are not font software.

Weather data, used only when the user turns weather on: forecasts and city
search results come from [Open-Meteo.com](https://open-meteo.com) at runtime
and are licensed [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/).
Hearth credits it in Settings, About ("Weather data by Open-Meteo.com, CC BY
4.0"). No Open-Meteo data or code is bundled; the last result is cached on the
device only. The weather condition glyphs are original to this project (below).

Original to this project (MIT): the wallpapers in `design/art/`, the Hearth
banner and launcher icon in `design/brand/`, the weather condition glyphs
(`app/src/main/res/drawable/weather_*.xml`, from `scripts/weather-glyphs.py`),
and the local demo implementation and original text-based tile layouts in
`design/demo-apps/` and `demoapps/`.

The demo tiles use the service names Netflix, Disney+, Hulu, ESPN, Prime Video,
and YouTube to illustrate a familiar TV setup. These names and any associated
trademarks belong to their respective owners and are not licensed under
Hearth's MIT license. The tiles use Instrument Sans, not downloaded official
logos or proprietary artwork. The demo apps are not official clients, contain
no streaming or login features, and do not imply affiliation or endorsement.
See [`docs/demo-apps.md`](../docs/demo-apps.md).

Not included: no code from Home on Fire (GPL-3.0-or-later) or any other app is
in this repository. `docs/home-button.md` only describes its behavior and cites
its source files.

Build and capture tools used by the scripts (headless Chrome, ffmpeg, Pillow,
numpy) are run from the developer's machine and are not distributed.

Test-only framework dependency: [Robolectric](https://github.com/robolectric/robolectric),
versions 4.14.1 and 4.16, [Apache License 2.0](https://github.com/robolectric/robolectric/blob/master/LICENSE).
Gradle downloads it and its Android framework test artifacts on CI. It is not
packaged in Hearth's APKs. The older version is limited to API 21/22 tests.

CI-only secret scanner: [Gitleaks 8.30.1](https://github.com/gitleaks/gitleaks/releases/tag/v8.30.1),
[MIT license](https://github.com/gitleaks/gitleaks/blob/v8.30.1/LICENSE).
CI downloads the official binary with a pinned SHA-256 checksum. It is not
bundled with the source or packaged in Hearth's APKs.
